NFL DFS Wide Receiver Rankings: Week 10 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 15 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 13, 10:49 AM ET

CeeDee Lamb is the top-projected wide receiver on the Week 10 DraftKings main slate at 20.1 DraftKings points for $8,800, against San Francisco. Jaxon Smith-Njigba (19.3, $9,300) and Chris Olave (16.9, $7,000) are next.

Drake London returns the most per dollar among wide receivers projected for at least 9 points: 2.43 projected points per $1,000 at $6,600.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 13, 10:49 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Wide receivers to know in Week 10

CeeDee Lamb, DAL vs SF ($8,800)

CeeDee Lamb carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 20.1 DraftKings points at $8,800. That is 0.8 points clear of Jaxon Smith-Njigba. The model gives him 10.7 targets on 32.5 routes. The salary works out to 2.29 projected points per $1,000, 6th of 24 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Lamb averaged 20.1 points with a simulated floor of 7.2 and a ceiling of 45.2, and he holds 16% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Dallas is a 3.5-point underdog at home against San Francisco, with an implied team total of 26 in a game totaled at 55.5.

Jaxon Smith-Njigba, SEA at LV ($9,300)

Jaxon Smith-Njigba projects 2nd at the position with 19.3 DraftKings points at $9,300. The model gives him 8.4 targets on 24.1 routes. The salary works out to 2.08 projected points per $1,000, 13th of 24 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Smith-Njigba averaged 19.4 points with a simulated floor of 5.9 and a ceiling of 43.1, and he holds 11% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Seattle is a 6.5-point favorite on the road against Las Vegas, with an implied team total of 23.5 in a game totaled at 40.5.

Chris Olave, NO vs CAR ($7,000)

Chris Olave projects 3rd at the position with 16.9 DraftKings points at $7,000. The model gives him 9.1 targets on 33.8 routes. The salary works out to 2.41 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 24 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Olave averaged 16.8 points with a simulated floor of 4.3 and a ceiling of 41.5, and he holds 21% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. New Orleans is a 2.5-point favorite at home against Carolina, with an implied team total of 25.5 in a game totaled at 48.5.

Value: Carnell Tate, TEN vs JAX ($5,200)

Carnell Tate projects for 12.5 DraftKings points at $5,200, which works out to 2.41 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 24 wide receivers the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 7.8 targets on 30.7 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Tate averaged 12.8 points with a simulated floor of 0.8 and a ceiling of 39.1, and he holds 15% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Tennessee is a 10.5-point underdog at home against Jacksonville, with an implied team total of 18 in a game totaled at 46.5.
